changelog:
pontx-posthog 1.0.0

- Initial release of the pontx-posthog skill.
- Supports PostHog project-token runtime capture, event batching, and remote feature-flag evaluation.
- Ensures caller-owned tokens remain local; Pontx Hub never stores or proxies project tokens or provider responses.
- Requires explicit confirmation before sending any provider request, with full local preview available for all actions.
- Emphasizes security and transparency for event capture, batching, and feature flag evaluation workflows.
summary: Use for PostHog project-token runtime capture, event batching, and remote feature-flag evaluation with caller-owned tokens, local previews, and explicit confirmation before any provider request.
